parse_trace_file: parse a single trace file into metadata, a DataFrame of events, and a symbol table
transform_correlation_to_index: transform correlation IDs to index_correlation for linking CPU CUDA launch events to GPU kernels in a trace DataFrame
add_fwd_bwd_links: add forward and backward link columns to a trace DataFrame to connect fwdbwd start and end events
Trace_load_traces: load and parse all trace files for a distributed ML training job with optional multiprocessing support
Trace_convert_time_series_to_events: convert time series DataFrame data into Chrome Trace Format counter events for a given counter name
